Support

SwiftChat is in alpha. If something breaks, a small, clear report helps us improve it.

Report an issue

Open an issue on GitHub with your SwiftChat version, macOS version, the affected feature, and steps to reproduce. Include the error shown by the app when possible.

Remove private text from screenshots and logs. Never share API keys, cookies, or account credentials.

Installing and updating

Download a published macOS release from GitHub Releases, extract it, and move SwiftChat to Applications. App updates are delivered through the built-in updater. You can also choose Check for Updates from the SwiftChat menu.

Connecting a provider

Open Settings → Accounts & Services. Use your own credentials for a supported AI provider, or sign in through the ChatGPT website. Provider subscriptions and usage charges are separate from SwiftChat.

Work with Apps

Connect a supported source from the composer, preview its text, and choose the available capture scope before sending. Sources include Safari’s current tab, Terminal, TextEdit, Notes, Xcode, Codex conversation excerpts, and recent chats from native Telegram for macOS. Sources are refreshed before sending; your own question stays in the composer.

Terminal and other Accessibility-based sources need Accessibility access in System Settings. Safari also needs Automation permission and permission for JavaScript from Apple Events. Telegram uses messages already synchronized in its local cache; media files are not captured.

AIChat tools

AIChat can work with files in SwiftChat’s working directory, operate the in-app browser, and generate interactive content. These tools require a model that supports tool calls, with context capacity and maximum output length configured.

As conversations grow, AIChat can summarize its working context for later model requests. The original conversation and complete tool results remain in history. Text, screenshots, and other tool results can be sent to the model service you select.

ChatGPT compatibility

ChatGPT Web is an unofficial integration and website changes may temporarily break it. Report compatibility errors with the app version and operation involved. The public adapter includes fixtures and protocol documentation.
